biotools.summary: TrAnnoScope is a Snakemake pipeline designed for full-length transcriptome analysis and functional annotation, capable of processing both Illumina short-read and PacBio long-read data. It provides a modular workflow for generating high-quality transcriptomes and assigning functional annotations from multiple databases.
